en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka; English synthesis from the officially published treaty text
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. Dividends paid by a company resident in one Contracting State to a resident of the other State may also be taxed in the State of the paying company. If the recipient is the beneficial owner, the source-State tax shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends. The reduced source treatment does not apply where the holding is effectively connected with a permanent establishment or fixed base in the source State.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka; English synthesis from the officially published treaty text
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. Interest arising in one Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other State may also be taxed in the source State. If the recipient is the beneficial owner, the source-State tax shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount. Interest connected with a loan or credit granted by a bank is subject to a maximum source-State rate of 5 per cent. Qualifying interest involving a Contracting State, its central bank, a government-owned or controlled financial institution, or qualifying government-supported financing is exempt in the source State under paragraph 3.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka; English synthesis from the officially published treaty text
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. Royalties arising in one Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other State may also be taxed in the source State if the recipient is the beneficial owner. The source-State tax shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount for copyright royalties concerning literary, artistic or scientific works, including cinematograph films and films or recordings for radio or television broadcasting. The source-State tax shall not exceed 10 per cent for royalties concerning patents, trademarks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, computer software, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment, or industrial, commercial or scientific experience.
